facts.fact: 苍白宫廷（Pallid Court）在代表团预定到达前两天又向堡垒投来一波 mutants，Aelindor 认定这是一个毫不掩饰的警告。
facts.quote: The Pallid Court had thrown another wave of mutants at us two days before the delegations were due.

facts.fact: Aelindor 认定自己必须让 Xander 到来，一切取决于此，他不忍看 Max 的希望破灭。
facts.quote: I needed Xander to come. Everything depended on it. I could not bear to watch Max’s hope shatter.

facts.fact: 战斗中 Aelindor 无法升空，只能守住堡垒中心，用 Stormglass 望远镜把战局拖近到眼前，看着堡垒边缘燃烧。
facts.quote: During the battle, I hadn’t been able to take to the sky. I’d had to hold the center of the fortress and watch through a Stormglass scope

facts.fact: Aelindor 在望远镜里看见 Max 肩上血晕扩散、自己的血她够不到，同时为她只训练一个月就打得像斯巴达人而骄傲。
facts.quote: She fought like a Spartan despite only a single month’s training to her name, as though war were a tongue she’d been born already speaking.

facts.fact: Aelindor 想起四人曾互相立誓：尊重 Max 自己选择做战士、绝不折断她的翅膀。
facts.quote: the four of us made one another a quiet vow: we would honor it. We would never clip her wings.

facts.fact: Aelindor 害怕因为拒绝圈禁她而失去她；他对自己说，如果她倒下，他会跟着她走进黑暗。
facts.quote: I would not walk that road tonight. If she fell, I would follow her into the dark.

facts.fact: Max 出现在月光下的前庭并抬头望向他的窗口，Aelindor 已经移动到门口等着她上楼。
facts.quote: She started for the house. I was already moving, so that by the time her foot touched the first stair she found me waiting in the open door.

facts.fact: 章末 Aelindor 终于接受这个事实：历经漫长世纪之后，他有了一个真正的伴侣（true mate）。
facts.quote: It’d taken me a while to come out of the shock of it—that after all these long centuries, I had a true mate at all.

relations: Aelindor 与 Max：真命伴侣（true mate），他体内的魔法在初见时便认出了她，她夜里滑冰前来寻他
Aelindor 与他的兄弟们（Nikolai、Caspian 等四位继承人）：共同立誓尊重 Max 作为战士的选择、绝不折她的翅膀
Max 与 Caspian：战友，战斗中 Caspian 站在她背后替她挡下 Aelindor 不在的位置
Max 与 Nikolai：师徒与战友，Nikolai 的暗色滑行训练已成为她的本能
Aelindor 与夜卫：夜卫跟了他几个世纪，知道 Max 对他的意义，主动退入树林放她进来
苍白宫廷（Pallid Court）与 Aelindor／四人：敌对，两日前再投 mutants 施压
Max 与 Xander the Collector：Aelindor 需要 Xander 到来，因为关系到 Max 的希望
